[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Agnes was baptized on 18-Dec-1726 in Kilwinning. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-1056|Hugh Glasgow]] and [[Kilpatrick-1635|Janet Kilpatrick]].
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1056]] is assessed at 98% (proved). Agnes’s 15 December birth and 18 December 1726 baptism explicitly name Hugh Glasgow and Janet Kilpatrick at Byres. Residence and father match the Patrick household; the maternal surname expansion is a small transcription/identity reservation, not an alternative father.

The Byres adult father is strongly identified; no new maternal identity or upstream Hugh ancestry is decided.

Next useful test: Compare pp74,127,208 originals for Patrick/Kilpatrick and any address or trade.

Source basis already held: [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F3626962&tab=this Agnes Glasgow — Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564-1929]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


[https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-87 Glasgow-87] is another Agnes Glasgow that was baptized nearby to different parents at roughly the same time.
